wiki_article:
**VISUAL SCHEMA // CRIMSON HEXAGON NAVIGATION MAP** is a **mislabeled manifestation** — a record whose title and body do not agree, and whose description says so.

The title identifies a Visual Schema. **The deposited body is the complete v4.1 navigation architecture**, integrating ninety-five documents — the same work held at #319.

The archive records the mismatch rather than resolving it silently, which is the standing practice for identity defects: the body is not overwritten, the title is not quietly changed, and the discrepancy is stated where a reader will meet it. It belongs to the same class as the confirmed wrong-object records (#436, #1193, #1356), distinguished from them by being a mislabel of a *seated* work rather than a substitution of a different one.
